summary_en: 5,000,000 shares (1.90% of S/O) acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥2,697.5/share (July 29, 2026 close), total ¥13.49B. Single-tranche block order executed July 30, 2026 at 08:45 JST. Consumes 20.0% of the ¥50B / 25M-share authorization approved May 29, 2026 (authorization window: June 1, 2026 – May 31, 2027).
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On July 29, 2026, KOITO Manufacturing's board authorized execution of a single off-hours block buyback under ToSTNeT-3. The company placed a buy order for 5,000,000 shares at the July 29 closing price of ¥2,697.5/share, for a total cost of ¥13.49B. The order was to be executed on July 30, 2026 at 08:45 JST and would be filled only during that designated trading window; no adjustment of share count was made, and execution was subject to market conditions. This block consumes 20% of the ¥50B upper limit and 5M-share authorization (9.50% of S/O ex-treasury, i.e., 25M shares) that the board had resolved on May 29, 2026 for the window June 1, 2026 – May 31, 2027. The stated rationale is to advance enterprise value through ongoing business investment while enhancing shareholder returns.
